detail.longDescription: Seriously thinking of installing Qubes OS as my main OS, to mitigate as much as possible security threats in the era of AI. It still feels like a hack though, "put together". I never understood why never anyone forked Android to make it a desktop OS (totally fork it that is). Android has the best security model (and compositor), it's just that it needs an updated kernel & libs. # security # hacking # ai # artificialintelligence # qubes
